policy: Every key under cases is an exact executable inventory ID. Pattern or wildcard entries never count as item-level execution coverage.

runner_contract.command: Non-empty argv array. The runner receives RP_ATOMIC_ITEM_ID and must exit non-zero on functional/oracle failure.
runner_contract.evidence_file: Runner-generated JSON bound to the exact item and commit; it must contain item_id, ok=true and oracle_observed=true.
